condition_description: Baseline control. Fixed round-budget progression with the current standard dialogue budget.
Dialogue-budget control. Fixed round-budget progression with more turns, isolating the effect of giving the discussion more space without gate logic.
Primary treatment. Evidence-gated progression with the standard dialogue budget to test whether gating improves evidence integration and accusation quality.
Robustness and mechanism cell. Evidence-gated progression plus more turns, testing whether gating still matters when the group is given a larger budget.
